'''Outriggers''' were a vehicle component used in [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] that extended from the front of a bike to support [[Steering vane/Legends|steering vanes]]. [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] had two [[Color/Legends|black]] outriggers built to withstand extreme torque. Each of the 74-Z's outriggers had two brown steering vanes attatched to its tip.<ref name="CV" />
